name: Manifold skid
function: The steel frame that carries the manifold, valves, and control unit as one lift and sets the layout of the branches to each well.

tabs.overview: Skid dimensions are set by the number of wells served and the spacing of the trees on the pad; the skid is set on mats and leveled so the outlet lines reach each tree without forcing the iron.
tabs.engineering: Structural steel; lifting points certified; grounded.
tabs.safety: The skid is set with a crane; the manifold is a heavy lift over the pad.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; no personnel under suspended tree or lubricator sections.
